title: operator/v1
description: D-19 v3.51 (i), F34-T13: a listed curator's record that ledger identities belong to one operator, the person who ran them. Appended under operators/<operator>/<timestamp>-<curator>.yaml; the newest record for an operator is the one read, and a record with no identities releases them. No ledger entry is changed.

operator.description: the operator's own pseudonym; the directory is named after it

identities.description: the ledger identities that are the operator's; empty releases every identity an earlier record named

reason.description: why, in the curator's words: the published reasoning a curator's act owes the record (D-22)
